# UO2 Property Comparison: Experimental vs DFT

The following table compares experimental and DFT calculated properties of UO2:

| Property | Experimental | DFT (PBE+U) | Unit |
|---|---|---|---|
| Lattice constant | 5.4704 | 5.498 | angstrom |
| Bulk modulus | 207 | 198 | GPa |
| Melting point | 3120 | 2900 | K |
| Thermal conductivity (300 K) | 8.0 | 7.5 | W/(m K) |
| Density | 10.97 | 10.85 | g/cm^3 |
| Band gap | 2.1 | 2.0 | eV |

The DFT calculations were performed within the PBE+U formalism.
